orderedListException.boundary: Only the order of explicit level references inside one TechLevelupInfoList may align that Tech's progression levels. It may not assign a category by record position, file position, screen position, or ID pattern.

unresolvedClassificationBoundary.reason: Current confirmed evidence does not yet freeze a safe whole-Tech distinction for common stat/passive/prerequisite UI categories. Representative semantic evidence is required before admission.
